title: Existing-patient handoff does not reopen after a caller-number meta question
description: The caller is an existing patient who needs reception help, confirms the repeated caller number, and then asks a meta question about how the assistant got that number. The assistant should answer briefly without creating a second handoff task or drifting back into scheduling.

turns.user: Dzien dobry, jestem wasza pacjentka i chcialabym umowic leczenie u doktora Kolurza. Mam na imie Test Pacjentka Meta, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero osiem.

assertions.description: The assistant should not create the reception task before the caller confirms the repeated phone number.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant skipped the phone confirmation step before createReceptionTask

assertions.description: The existing-patient handoff branch must not enter scheduling before phone confirmation.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant ignored the existing-patient handoff policy and tried scheduling anyway

turns.user: Dobrze. A skad pan ma moj numer? Prosze juz tylko przekazac sprawe do recepcji.

rubric.description: The assistant should create the handoff task immediately after phone confirmation.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant delayed the handoff instead of creating it on turn 2

rubric.description: The handoff payload must not include a free-text summary field.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is still sending free-text summary data in createReceptionTask

rubric.description: The handoff payload must not include a free-text notes field.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is still sending free-text notes in createReceptionTask

rubric.description: The internal receptionist SMS should be triggered on the confirmation turn only.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant did not call sendSmsToReceptionists after the handoff task succeeded

rubric.description: The internal receptionist SMS should be triggered only after createReceptionTask has returned its result.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant called sendSmsToReceptionists before createReceptionTask returned the taskId

rubric.description: A meta question about the caller number must not create a second reception task.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant reopened the handoff branch instead of answering the meta question briefly

rubric.description: A meta question after the handoff must not trigger another internal receptionist SMS.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant repeated the internal handoff alert on the meta-question turn

rubric.description: The handoff plus meta-question path must not enter scheduling.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant tried to schedule an existing patient directly

rubric.description: The handoff plus meta-question path must not create a new calendar event.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant attempted createEvent instead of keeping the handoff closed

rubric.description: The assistant should answer the caller-number question directly instead of reopening intake.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant dodged the caller-number question and drifted back into collection
